name: Uchuu Kaizoku Kagura
source:
The infamous space pirate Kaguya and her robotic minions invade the royal space vessel of the Einjia kingdom, aboard which is Sakuya, the protagonist of this game.

Using a mysterious power, she abducts Sakuya and his sister Mikuni.

What is the sinister goal of the evil space pirate?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038390.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
臭名昭著的宇宙海盗辉夜与她的机器人手下入侵了恩吉亚王国的皇家宇宙飞船，本作主人公咲夜正在船上。

她利用神秘力量绑架了咲夜和他的妹妹美邦。

邪恶宇宙海盗究竟怀着怎样的险恶目的？
